jsesh.mdcDisplayer.swing.editor
Class MDCEditorKeyManager

java.lang.Object
  java.awt.event.KeyAdapter
      jsesh.mdcDisplayer.swing.editor.MDCEditorKeyManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.util.EventListener, java.awt.event.KeyListener
public class MDCEditorKeyManager
extends java.awt.event.KeyAdapter

Manages input for an MDC Editor. It might be interesting to make it public. This class uses the "singleton" design pattern, as it is stateless. IMPORTANT : clean. Suppress unused stuff.

Author:
rosmord
